item.title: 🔧 Planned works at Perplexity
item.description:
Status page migration to incident.io

Scheduled maintenance · Status: scheduled · Affects: Computer, Website, API · Opened: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 21:00:00 +0000

Type: Maintenance Affected Components: Computer, Website, API Jan 1, 00:00:00 GMT+0 - Identified - On Thursday, September 10 around 21:00 UTC (2:00 PM Pacific), we will migrate our status page from Instatus to incident.io as part of consolidating our incident response tooling. The switch is a DNS change, so it may take some time to complete for everyone. ## What is and isn't changing * The status page URL stays the same: . * Historical incidents have been migrated, so past incident history remains available on the new page. * Email subscribers will be migrated automatically. No action needed.…

item.title: 🟢 Replit sorted itself out after a while
item.description:
Some users are unable to publish apps with an external DATABASE_URL error

Impact: minor · Status: resolved · Opened: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 17:19:07 +0000

[Resolved] We've deployed a fix for the issue causing some projects to fail publishing with a DATABASE_URL error, and publishing should work normally now. If you're seeing missing data in your development database, columns that appear to be gone, or a migration with an unusually high number of drop statements, please contact support (replit.com/help) so we can look into it with you directly. Thanks for your patience while we worked through this.
